title: Drinking Water from Thin Air: Solar-Dew Point Water Harvesting (Ask This Old House, Future House)

locations.name: Phoenix, Arizona, USA (probable demonstration site)
locations.basis: Transcript situates the activity in Phoenix (Sonoran Desert in Phoenix) and references a Phoenix-based company.

summary: This Old House’s Future House episode documents a Phoenix-based off-grid system that extracts drinking water from humid air using solar energy. The presenters explain dew-point concepts, the integration of a sponge-like material inside a dedicated panel, and how a combined solar photovoltaic and solar thermal setup raises the air’s dew point to condense water. The installation hub distributes water from an 8.5 gallon reservoir through a three-eighths inch line to the house (including a refrigerator), powered entirely by solar energy with a microprocessor-controlled system. A mineral block is added to improve taste, and the video discusses practical applications, approximate cost (a few thousand dollars), and yield (a few gallons per day), highlighting scenarios—from arid locales to developing regions—where self-contained, infrastructure-free water could be transformative. The segment culminates with notes on deployment in six countries and the potential for broader adoption as technology matures.
topics: Applications in arid regions and developing countries
